# DeepSeek Harness Desktop

> DeepSeek Harness Desktop is a community-maintained, open-source Windows desktop distribution for DeepSeek Harness. It preserves the complete Harness Web Surface and adds ChatGPT OAuth, OpenAI Codex models, model-aware reasoning effort, native desktop lifecycle management, plugins, 11 skins, automatic updates, and mobile remote access.

## Canonical website

- https://ningbainb.github.io/deepseek-harness-desktop/

## Key facts

- Supported systems: Windows 10 and Windows 11, x64
- Current release: v0.1.9
- v0.1.9 fixes conversation copying, downloads desktop updates in the background, refreshes the startup and update surfaces, and adds guarded community-plugin compatibility checks, offline switching, and rollback
- The bundled Skin Center includes 11 selectable skins
- Node.js is bundled; end users do not need to install it separately
- The project is a community edition and is not an official DeepSeek release
- QQ user community: 1105158177
